page.overview:
Who is Torul Blom?

Torul Blom was a male Pau'an politician who served as governor of Pau City on Utapau during the Clone Wars.

When Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were sent to Utapau to investigate the death of Jedi Master Tu-Anh, Blom met them to inform that their presence had upset Pau City citizens, as well as to deny the Confederacy of Independent Systems' presence on the planet.

It was later revealed that the Pau'an governor was in league with the arms dealer Endente and Separatist leader Count Dooku. As Blom awaited for Endente to arrive with a massive kyber crystal that was valuable to the CIS, he was informed of the arrival of Count Dooku's enforcer, General Grievous. He was present when Endente came empty-handed into his office and witnessed the Sugi's decapitation at the hands of Grievous for his failure. When Kenobi and Skywalker returned to Pau City to request his help, Blom had them arrested and retrieved the crystal for his Separatist allies.

His victory was short-lived as his men and B1-series battle droids were defeated and the two Jedi escaped. Grievous arrived a few moments after the duo had fled and seemed quite angered. Realizing his mistake, the governor told the cyborg warlord that he was sorry for the complication, at which Grievous stabbed Blom with a lightsaber, killing him and scornfully remarking that only now was he truly sorry.
